ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a tripolar grid type.
description: Cells centred on the y-velocity (v) points of the MOM6 Arakawa-C grid on the nominal 0.5 degree tripolar grid, i.e. the midpoints of the northern and southern faces of the tracer cells (tracer cells: see the MOM6 0.5 degree mass grid cell, alias MOM6-0.5deg-mass). There are 720 x 577 = 415440 points as stored by the model with symmetric memory: 577 rows of faces for 576 rows of tracer cells, including the closed southern boundary row at 78S where v is identically zero.
